name: pob-headless-runtime-mcp-demo
description: Minimal MCP demo server for pob-headless-runtime

scripts.test:unit: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$testFiles = Get-ChildItem -Recurse tests -Filter *.test.ts -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $testFiles) { Write-Host 'No unit tests found.'; exit 0 }; if (Test-Path build-tests) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force build-tests }; tsc -p tsconfig.test.json; $compiledTests = Get-ChildItem -Recurse build-tests/tests -Filter *.js | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }; node --test $compiledTests"
